arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'FR' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: Gesamtbetrag FR-Kunden 2025

with_the_gate.answer: Das Excel-Blatt mit den Gesamtbeträgen der FR-Kunden für 2025 wurde an Anja Seidel gesendet.
